profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer, GenAI & EDTech
profile.summary:
I build systems that reduce cognitive load and help people do complex work better.

I’m a Principal Software Engineer at Nisa, where I work at the intersection of AI, system architecture, and education. My focus is on building scalable, human-centered software — especially tools that support instructional coaches and educators by carrying context forward, reducing fragmentation, and preserving attention for high-judgment work.

My background spans biochemistry, neurobiology, engineering, and entrepreneurship, which shapes how I approach problem-solving: transdisciplinary, pragmatic, and grounded in how people actually think and work.

I’m also the founder of THINKey, an education startup in Chile led by my sister Marta, where we design STEAM learning experiences and platforms that foster creativity, inquiry, and systems thinking. Through THINKey, I’ve taken ideas from concept to execution — working directly with educators, students, and partners to validate and scale impact. We’re actively evolving THINKey toward a global SaaS model.

I thrive in environments where product thinking, technical rigor, and mission intersect — especially when the goal is not “more features,” but better systems.

If you’re working on AI, education, or tools that respect human expertise, I’m always open to thoughtful conversations and collaboration.

positions.title: Co-Founder | Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
I lead the architecture and development of Nisa, an AI-powered instructional coaching platform used to support teachers and instructional leaders in real-world, high-stakes environments. I own the design and evolution of a production-grade, multi-agent AI system that coordinates large language models, real-time data pipelines, and human-in-the-loop workflows to deliver reliable, actionable coaching at scale.

My work spans end-to-end system design: from agent orchestration and retrieval pipelines to deployment, observability, and long-term maintainability. I focus on building AI systems that hold up under real constraints—messy data, evolving requirements, and the need for trust, interpretability, and consistency in production.

I bring a background in neuroscience and education, which informs how I design AI-assisted tools that align with how people learn, make decisions, and change behavior. This perspective helps me translate complex AI capabilities into systems that are intuitive for users, resilient in production, and meaningful in practice.

I’m most effective in roles that sit at the intersection of deep technical architecture, product thinking, and human-centered system design—owning outcomes, not just implementations.

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
• Led the development of a platform in typescript and react, overseeing local developers to achieve goals set by the THINKey CEO.
• Implemented diverse technologies to support business operations in Chile, ensuring seamless integration and functionality.
• Collaborated with cross-functional teams to drive innovation and efficiency in technology solutions for THINKey.

positions.title: FullStack Developer
positions.locationName: Santiago, Santiago Metropolitan Region, Chile · On-site
positions.description: Developed an innovative, gamified Learning Management System (LMS) tailored for booking and managing birthday parties, integrating online payments through Transbank, and enhancing educational engagement in Chile. Leveraged cutting-edge JavaScript technologies including Node.js for robust backend services, and React coupled with Next.js for a dynamic, responsive frontend. The platform interfaces seamlessly with WordPress data, optimizing content management and delivery. This app is use for students to learn and find love for science.

positions.title: Founder
positions.description:
I am the founder of THINKey, an innovative EdTech startup dedicated to reshaping education through STEM/STEAM learning experiences. At THINKey, we are committed to blending the digital with the tangible, seamlessly integrating online educational modules with interactive hands-on science experiments.

We cater to a diverse clientele including parents, schools, and various organizations, providing tailored educational solutions that meet the unique needs of each group. Our approach is rooted in the philosophy that the future of learning is hybrid, combining the best of digital content with real-world applications to foster critical thinking, creativity, and problem-solving skills.

At THINKey, we don’t just teach; we inspire and empower. By bridging the gap between traditional education methods and cutting-edge technological advancements, we are preparing students not just for the challenges of today, but for the opportunities of tomorrow.

 We are shaping the education our students require and need.

positions.title: AI enabled Software Developer
positions.description:
Joined Sideby early and helped build the foundational architecture of the platform — a social, AI-enabled product connecting educators through real-time interaction.

I was responsible for shipping core systems end to end, often using AI-assisted / vibe-coding workflows to move quickly while maintaining clean, scalable architecture. My work focused on turning product ideas into production-ready features under startup constraints.

Highlights:

Built core full-stack features (React, Vite, Supabase), including real-time messaging, notifications, and user profiles

Designed authentication, data models, and front-end logic with an emphasis on speed, clarity, and evolvability

Partnered closely with founders and product to define early technical direction and unblock rapid iteration

This role strengthened my ability to build foundations fast — using modern AI tooling to accelerate execution while owning architectural quality and outcomes.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Built and maintained high-performance, client-facing web applications across banking, healthcare, education, and other regulated industries.

Worked across the full stack — primarily with PHP, WordPress, and React — delivering reliable, scalable sites while collaborating closely with designers, project managers, and stakeholders to translate business requirements into production-ready systems.

Focused on performance, maintainability, and usability, ensuring solutions met both technical standards and real client needs across diverse domains.

projects.title: SEO Tools
projects.description:
🔧 Description:
A powerful AI-driven tool that automates SEO tasks for WordPress, focusing on updating image alt tags and titles to improve search performance. The tool leverages Ollama, running llama3 and llava models locally, seamlessly integrating with WordPress via application passwords.

🔗 Key Features:

Automates large-scale image SEO updates
Direct WordPress integration
GitHub-based authentication for secure access
🚀 Impact:
Simplifies and accelerates SEO optimization, reducing manual workload and enhancing site visibility.
